audience: Age 5 / Kindergarten core with readiness-based early Grade 1 extension
principles: Each academic subject follows one consistent visual learning trail; the trail never chooses curriculum.
Every day includes reading/phonics and math, then writing/language and discovery/logic rotation.
Scheduled targets are readiness-aware: due review or an unlocked prerequisite may replace a target within the same subject trail.
Connected text appears regularly once decoding prerequisites are ready.
Handwriting includes touch practice and paper practice; touch tracing is not treated as a formal handwriting assessment.
Accuracy, independence, retention and support are tracked separately rather than collapsed into one child score.
Off-screen movement, conversation and pencil work are part of the planned 30 minutes.

weeks.title: Welcome to the Trails
weeks.goal: Learn the app routine, how print works, early counting and careful observing.

weeks.title: Rhymes, Names & Small Numbers
weeks.goal: Play with rhyme and syllables while building quantity and letter confidence.

weeks.title: First Sounds & Counting Objects
weeks.goal: Hear beginning sounds and count real groups carefully.

weeks.title: Blend the Sounds
weeks.goal: Blend and stretch spoken words while comparing groups.

weeks.title: Letter-Sound Magic
weeks.goal: Connect consonant letters with sounds and compose small numbers.

weeks.title: Short-Vowel Garden
weeks.goal: Hear short vowels, build simple words and act out addition.

weeks.title: CVC Word Woods
weeks.goal: Read and spell short-vowel words; take apart subtraction stories.

weeks.title: Heart Words & Number Bonds
weeks.goal: Add useful common words to decodable reading and find parts of ten.

weeks.title: Sentence Lanterns
weeks.goal: Read and build short sentences; solve missing-part puzzles.

weeks.title: Digraph Reef
weeks.goal: Read sh, ch, th, wh, ck and ng while exploring repeating patterns.

weeks.title: Blend Bridge
weeks.goal: Read consonant blends and use spatial words with 2D shapes.

weeks.title: Story Castle Opens
weeks.goal: Read connected decodable text and meet solid shapes.

weeks.title: Build & Compose
weeks.goal: Build larger shapes from smaller shapes and tell stories in order.

weeks.title: Measure the Kingdom
weeks.goal: Compare length, height, weight and capacity while reading for meaning.

weeks.title: Sort, Count & Explain
weeks.goal: Organize simple data and explain observations with clear sentences.

weeks.title: Teen Number Tower
weeks.goal: Understand 11–19 as ten and some more; strengthen fluent reading.

weeks.title: Silent-e Aurora
weeks.goal: Notice how final e changes a vowel sound and revisit operations.

weeks.title: Count Higher
weeks.goal: Count forward toward 100 by ones and tens while consolidating phonics.

weeks.title: Vowel-Team Lookout
weeks.goal: Read a small readiness-based vowel-team set while solving mixed number puzzles.

weeks.title: Read, Think, Explain
weeks.goal: Use connected text every day and explain math and story reasoning.

weeks.title: Shape & Story Festival
weeks.goal: Review geometry, story structure and descriptive language.

weeks.title: Scientist Week
weeks.goal: Read informational-style sentences, organize data and make predictions.

weeks.title: Puzzle Champion Week
weeks.goal: Use memory, patterns and coding while reviewing high-value academic skills.

weeks.title: Independent Adventure
weeks.goal: Practice at the strongest appropriate level with less scaffolding.

weeks.title: Portfolio & Review
weeks.goal: Revisit skills that need evidence and create a small reading, writing and math portfolio.

weeks.title: Celebration & Next Steps
weeks.goal: Collect independent evidence, celebrate growth and choose the next learning frontier.
